known_limitations: The delegated qualification ran inside a transient Delegate=yes systemd unit created by the operator. It qualifies the production code path on real cgroup v2; it is not an installed-path or production-root qualification and neither is claimed.
The trusted manager leaf holding the live controller is a disclosed residual cgroup for the controller's lifetime, reclaimed on unit teardown. It is never reported as manually removed.

On hosts without cgroup v2 delegation the mechanism in force remains RLIMIT and is still recorded honestly.
Milestone 3 remains forbidden and was not started.
b25_cgroup_topology_closure.root_cause_closed: probe_cgroup_delegation() was a false-positive readiness probe; the delegated parent still held the controller, so cgroup v2's no-internal-process constraint kept cgroup.subtree_control empty and per-effect limit writes failed with EACCES after readiness had promised CGROUP_V2_AND_RLIMIT.

b25_cgroup_topology_closure.supersession_scope: Only the M2-B25 physical-qualification refusal is lifted. Every other claim, disposition, count, and verdict recorded for the fourth repair pass stands unchanged as historical evidence.
